第459章 虚界也有污染（第1页）
虚界也有污染？（虚界也有污染？（第22页）索托斐仁等人看着陈奕这大变活人的模样，惊讶不已。
“不像啊，我的神识没看出任何异常。”
“会不会是我们太弱，看不出前辈的伪装？”
陈奕告诉他们这不是幻术，而是实打实的变了。
现在，不仅陈奕要变，陈奕要求他们六个也得变。
“我倒是会一点变化的幻术，可是只要是幻术就有可能被识破的。”
“是啊，我们不可能像前辈这样直接改变身体。”
“很简单，你们只要心中不反对，同意和我变得一样，就能变。”
陈奕要利用的不是“有人模仿我的脸”
这个绿色词条只能让别人把脸变成和自己一样，对于陈奕接下来要做的事情来说不够用。
但陈奕还有一个史诗词条“六耳猕猴”
，可以让别人变得完全和自己一样——仅限外貌，和修为、神通等毫无关系。
只是也有前提限制，必须对方自愿。
他们很清楚，陈奕带他们过来就是让他们继续当江洋大盗。
变身完毕后，索托斐仁六个心中更加惊叹。
这个人族护道者到底什么来头，这都是些什么稀奇的手段？看着和自己完全一样的六个人，陈奕从储物戒指中取出了一些化妆用品丢给他们。
“给自己脸上涂点东西，咱们要是以六胞胎示人，未免太过有记忆点。”
经过简单的化妆后，陈奕开始给六个人分派任务。
绚岚五杰继续搜集材料，并且要带一个陈奕的分身在身边，为的是利用分身词条的机制“即时通讯”
在搜集材料的过程中，一定要打着龙人族的名义——虽然这是显而易见的了。
同时，还要有意无意的放出风声，他们搜集这些材料，是为了打造更为强大的龙人武器——虚界的龙人族擅长制造各种古里古怪的兵器是众所周知的事情。
索托斐仁则是继续跟着陈奕当跟班，打打下手。
六人将右拳举过头顶，这是翼族表示“明白”
随后，绚岚五杰带上陈三，向陈奕指明的方向飞去。
“就是有个圣龙人，我要是把他杀了，圣龙族里的一些重要人物会非常愤怒，跟我不死不休那种。”
索托斐仁用一种“人为什么要给自己找这么大麻烦”
索托斐仁立马就懂了陈奕要干什么。
“不管哪个世界，权力最顶尖的存在最在乎的一定是自己的继承者。
好比我们翼族的福莱神，若是将福莱神的儿子，也就是我们翼族的神子击杀，福莱神定会怒火冲天！”
抓几个圣龙人问问，他们这儿的‘神子’是谁，然后……乃伊做特！”

Chapter 459 There is also pollution in the virtual world (page 1)
Is there pollution in the virtual world too? (Is the virtual world also polluted? (Page 22) Sotoferen and others were surprised when they saw Chen Yi's transformation into a living person.
"It's not like that. My consciousness didn't see anything unusual."
"Is it possible that we are too weak to see through the disguise of our seniors?"
Chen Yi told them that this was not an illusion, but a real change.
Now, not only Chen Yi wants to change, but Chen Yi requires the six of them to change too.
"I know a little bit of illusion magic, but as long as it's an illusion, it can be seen through."
"Yeah, we can't directly change the body like our predecessors."
"It's very simple. As long as you don't object in your heart and agree to become the same as me, you can change."
What Chen Yi wants to take advantage of is not "someone imitating my face"
This green entry can only make other people's faces look like his, which is not enough for what Chen Yi will do next.
But Chen Yi also has an epic entry "Six-eared Macaque"
, can make others become exactly like you - only in appearance, and has nothing to do with cultivation, magical powers, etc.
However, there are also prerequisite restrictions, and the other party must be voluntary.
They knew very well that Chen Yi brought them here just to let them continue to be gangsters.
After the transformation was completed, Sotoferen and the others were even more amazed.
What is the origin of this human protector, and what are these strange methods? Looking at the six people who were exactly the same as himself, Chen Yi took out some cosmetics from the storage ring and threw them to them.
"Put something on your face. If we show ourselves as sextuplets, it would be too memorable."
After simple makeup, Chen Yi began to assign tasks to six people.
The Five Heroes of Xuanlan continue to collect materials, and they want to bring a clone of Chen Yi with them in order to use the mechanism of the clone entry for "instant communication"
In the process of collecting materials, it must be done in the name of the dragon tribe - although this is obvious.
At the same time, it is necessary to spread the word intentionally or unintentionally that they collect these materials in order to build more powerful dragon weapons. It is well known that the dragon people in the virtual world are good at making all kinds of weird weapons.
Sotoferen continued to follow Chen Yi as a follower, playing tricks.
The six people raised their right fists above their heads, which was a sign of "understanding" from the Wing Clan.
Afterwards, the Five Heroes of Xuanlan took Chen San and flew in the direction indicated by Chen Yi.
"There is a Holy Dragon man. If I kill him, some important figures in the Holy Dragon clan will be very angry and will fight to the death with me."
Sotoferen used a "Why do people give themselves so much trouble?"
Sotoferen immediately understood what Chen Yi was going to do.
“No matter which world, the most powerful being must care most about his successor.
Just like the God Fulai of our Wing Clan, if he kills the son of God Fulai, the son of God of our Wing Clan, God Fulai will definitely be furious! "
Grab a few Holy Dragon people and ask them who their 'son of god' is, and then... I will do something special! "
